articles.title: John F. Kennedy Jr.'s Enduring Influence on Men's Fashion
articles.summary: The style of John F. Kennedy Jr. has become iconic in men's fashion and continues to inspire today.
articles.content: John F. Kennedy Jr.'s style was not a one-off phenomenon of the 1990s. He wasn't the first person to wear a suit while riding a bike, nor did he invent the backward Kangol cap or pinstriped suit. However, Kennedy Jr. managed to pull off these fashion risks with an ease that others could only dream of. His style has become iconic and continues to inspire men's fashion today, nearly three decades after his untimely death. As part of researching a book about Kennedy Jr.'s life, I spent the last year immersed in his world, pouring over photos, reading biographies, and speaking with people who knew him. This immersion has given me a deeper understanding of what made his style so enduringly popular. The sheer number of people who crossed paths with Kennedy Jr. during his prime is staggering - virtually everyone who lived in Manhattan in the 1990s encountered him at some point or another. JFK Jr.'s style was built on four fundamental elements: impeccable tailoring, classic preppy basics, functional workwear, and versatile sportswear. These pillars formed the foundation of his wardrobe, which he expertly blended to create some of his most iconic looks, such as pairing a suit with a backward baseball cap or wearing a polo neck sweater under a tweed blazer with hiking boots. One aspect of his style that's notable by its absence is jeans. While many people in the 1990s wore them frequently, JFK Jr. rarely donned denim, and some speculate it was due to his mother's preference for more refined attire. However, this doesn't mean you can't draw inspiration from his style without resorting to copying his exact looks. By understanding the balance of contrast that made his combinations work, you can create your own unique take on 1990s fashion icons like Ralph Lauren and Jerry Seinfeld, who popularized the preppy aesthetic during that era. JFK Jr.'s love for discordant accessories added a unique touch to his outfits, often clashing with his preppy aesthetic. His collection of flat caps, wallet chain, and Oakley Eye Jacket shades showcased his willingness to experiment with different styles. While some of these accessories were practical, such as the wallet chain which helped him keep track of his belongings, others reflected his personality and interests. For instance, his love for color was evident in his funky knit caps, while his enthusiasm for skiing was reflected in his fleece headbands. When it comes to accessorizing, it's essential to choose items that resonate with your personal style. If you have a connection to an accessory, whether it's due to a fond memory or a shared interest, it will shine through in your outfit. JFK Jr. often wore scarves as outerwear, pairing them with casual and formal attire alike. He would tie his scarf in either a dressy overhand knot or a classic Parisian knot, adding a touch of sophistication to even the most relaxed outfits. A scarf often served as an outer layer for him on chilly days, tossed over a sweatshirt rather than worn as a coat, sometimes paired with a knit cap to complete his look. When choosing a scarf, it's best not to match it too closely with the rest of your outfit. This allows for a more interesting and nuanced combination of pieces. His watch collection was another aspect of his style that caught my attention. I found evidence of a wide range of timepieces in various styles and price points, from a practical Victorinox Swiss Army field watch to a vintage Rolex Oyster Perpetual. He didn't seem to be bound by any particular brand or budget when it came to watches, deriving equal pleasure from affordable quartz models as he did from luxury mechanical ones. His wardrobe was an eclectic mix of high-end and low-key pieces, reflecting his background as a downtown socialite. In addition to bespoke suits and tuxedos, he had a notable collection of graphic tees from iconic NYC institutions such as the Russian & Turkish Baths in the East Village and the New York Athletic Club. These shirts not only showcased his love for the city's diverse culture but also highlighted significant events like the 1984 NYC Fresh Festival, which played a pivotal role in hip-hop history. His affinity for these graphic tees demonstrated an appreciation for local heritage and community. His style was more than just about the clothes he wore; it was about embracing individuality and authenticity, making him a compelling figure to learn from. articles.title: Delta Air Lines Launches Nonstop Service from Austin to Northwest Arkansas
articles.summary: Delta has filed plans for nonstop flights from Austin Bergstrom International Airport to Northwest Arkansas National Airport, with service set to begin in March 2027.
articles.content: Delta Air Lines has filed plans to launch nonstop service from Austin Bergstrom International Airport (AUS) to Northwest Arkansas National Airport (XNA), located outside Bentonville. Flights are scheduled to begin in March 2027 and will be operated by a Delta Connection regional jet, providing passengers with a convenient option for travel between the two destinations. The new route is expected to connect Austin to northwest Arkansas, as well as parts of Oklahoma, Missouri, and Kansas that are relatively close to XNA. The addition of this route marks another expansion in Delta's growing presence at Austin Bergstrom International Airport. The airline has been increasing its services from the airport, including a recent announcement about nonstop flights to Paris, which will begin in April. This new route is part of Delta's ongoing efforts to establish itself as a major player in the region. The Northwest Arkansas National Airport is also an important hub for travelers heading to the University of Arkansas, making this new service particularly convenient for students and staff. With its location near several major cities, XNA offers easy access to parts of Oklahoma, Missouri, and Kansas, further expanding Delta's reach in the region. Delta's expansion in Austin continues to gain momentum, with plans to operate up to 70 daily departures from the city's airport by March. This significant increase is a testament to the airline's growing presence in the region. The growth of Delta's operations in Austin has been nothing short of remarkable, with peak daily departures increasing from 28 in 2019 to an expected 70 by March. According to Joe Esposito, Delta's chief commercial officer, this expansion will also lead to more itineraries with connections in Texas for passengers. While Delta has made significant strides in Austin, the airline has been clear that it does not intend to establish a hub at the city's airport. Instead, its goal is to become the primary business carrier in Austin, surpassing other corporate carriers in the region. Delta's expansion plans in Austin continue to take shape as the airline adds a new direct route to Northwest Arkansas. This latest move is part of Delta's commitment to growing alongside the Austin community and making travel more convenient for locals. As the market leader at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport, Southwest Airlines also has ambitious plans in store for 2027. The carrier intends to offer its biggest schedule ever from AUS next year, a significant increase in flight offerings that will undoubtedly boost air travel options for passengers. In addition to Delta's new route and Southwest's expanded schedule, the airport is set to welcome several other developments. One of these includes the opening of an inaugural lounge by Southwest Airlines, which will provide travelers with a comfortable space to relax before their flights. Meanwhile, Delta plans to establish a second Sky Club at AUS in the coming years, one that will be larger than its current facility. Delta's expansion efforts are also contributing to air service growth in Northwest Arkansas, where the airline is launching a new route. This move comes on the heels of significant increases in total flights at XNA this year, with data from Cirium indicating a 28% jump in flights compared to two years ago. Delta has significantly expanded its presence in Austin, a focus city for the carrier, by adding new routes to several key destinations. Notably, Delta's service to Bentonville is not limited to Austin alone; it also operates from five other airports that are major hubs for the airline. These airports include Atlanta, Detroit, Minneapolis, Salt Lake City and New York's LaGuardia Airport (LGA), demonstrating Delta's extensive network and connectivity options for its passengers. articles.title: USC Star JuJu Watkins Completes Recovery from ACL Injury
articles.summary: USC star JuJu Watkins is set to return to action after completing her lengthy recovery from an ACL injury that occurred in March 2025.
articles.content: USC star JuJu Watkins has finally completed her lengthy road to recovery from an ACL injury and is set to return to action for the Trojans. Watkins' absence was deeply felt last season as USC struggled without its top player, finishing with an underwhelming record. The 2026-27 season is a new chapter for the team, with high expectations as they enter the campaign as the No.3-ranked team in the country and are expected to contend for a national championship. Watkins' return has significantly boosted the Trojans' chances of achieving this goal, given her status as arguably the best player in college basketball when healthy. Watkins' ACL tear occurred during a pivotal moment in the NCAA Tournament, as she was going for a layup against Mississippi State when she collided with multiple defenders. The impact was immediate and severe, causing Watkins to crumple to the ground and clutch her right knee in pain. She required assistance off the court as she struggled to put weight on her injured leg. This devastating injury forced Watkins to undergo surgery just weeks later, effectively ruling out any possibility of returning for the remainder of the 2025 season. The lengthy recovery period has now spanned nearly two years, with Watkins set to take the floor again when USC opens its new campaign. As Watkins continued her rehabilitation journey, she had to adopt a more deliberate approach than usual. She revealed that her rehab process involved slowing down and revisiting the fundamental skills of basketball, which she hadn't done since learning them initially. This meant spending time in the weight room before progressing to stationary movements like catching and shooting hoops. According to Watkins, this gradual progression was essential for her recovery, despite feeling the urge to rush back onto the court sooner. The lengthy rehabilitation period allowed Watkins to appreciate the journey and its challenges. She described it as a humbling experience that taught her patience and made her stronger in the long run. JuJu Watkins' recovery from an ACL injury has been a long and challenging process for the USC star. She suffered the injury on March 24, 2025, during a game against Mississippi State in the NCAA tournament, where she played just five minutes before leaving due to her injury. Her performance was impressive despite the short time she spent on the court, as she managed to collect three points before exiting the game. This setback came after an impressive run of durability for Watkins, who had played 37 games across her first two collegiate seasons. The impact of her absence was felt by USC, which struggled to a 18-14 record and lost in the second round of the NCAA tournament as a No. 9 seed. Despite these challenges, Watkins' experience has likely made her stronger and more patient, a sentiment she's shared about her recovery process.
